problem: Returning library launches enabled ambient handle inheritance without an explicit allowlist. Unrelated inheritable caller handles could reach the child.
repair: Use an explicit list of the selected standard-handle duplicates for returning launches. Enable inheritance only when that list is nonempty. With no selected standard handles, omit the explicit standard-handle startup flag in the returning branch. Original caller handles and flags are unchanged.
preserved: atomic Job assignment at suspended creation
existing CLI native launch arguments and console flags

build.testkit_feature: Enabled through the existing development dependency; these are test builds.

focused_regression.name: g43_library_run_inherits_only_selected_standard_handles
cases: detached parent, all standard handles missing
oracles: Exact binary stream bytes including NUL and CRLF
Caller standard-handle slots and original handle flags unchanged
Unnamed inheritable caller event remains unsignaled after the child attempts SetEvent on its numeric slot
Original caller event remains usable by its owner
Every supplied child standard slot exists; an unsupplied slot must be absent or affirmatively verified as a native console handle
focused_regression.observed_defaults: Windows initialized a console stderr for the partial case and three console handles for the all-missing case. Native file type, console mode and console codepage observations were retained. These defaults do not carry the caller event.

final_qualification.clippy: Exited zero under repository policy. One new test-only type_complexity warning from the broader run was removed. The final diagnostics have no warning on changed lines; existing repository warnings remain.

preserved_failed_attempts.reason: Default GNU Rust toolchain lacked the requested MSVC standard library. No test ran.

The original partial-stream test used an absence-only stderr expectation. Child exited 101 without a captured child assertion message; stderr was not supplied by its parent, and its native stderr slot was unobserved.

Added diagnostics established that Windows supplied native console stderr, causing the original absence assertion to fail. The prospective oracle was corrected for a fresh run; this failed run was not rescored.

independent_review.scope: The exact returning-library handle repair, final regression, actual receipts, and stated compatibility. Public-summary factual review is a separate step.
